blocks.html:
This method retrieves a customer by its ID. It sends a request to the
[Get Customer](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#customers\_getcustomersid)
API route.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the customer.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request.

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: has_account
children.description: Whether the customer is a guest.

children.name: groups
children.description: The groups the customer is in.

children.name: default_billing_address_id
children.description: The ID of the customer's default billing address.

children.name: default_shipping_address_id
children.description: The ID of the customer's default shipping address.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The ID of the user that created the customer.

children.name: deleted_at
children.description: The date the customer was deleted.

children.name: created_at
children.description: The date the customer was created.

children.name: updated_at
children.description: The date the customer was updated.
